title: 第三十章 五师兄第三十一章 得手
content_zh:
望着众人离去的背影，秦凤鸣不由感到了些许异样。
对于那五名滞留在分舵之人，秦凤鸣并未什么异样感觉。
但那两名步向分舵外面的中年，在离开那处楼殿之时，却相互对望了一眼。
虽然此动作并无什么奇异之处，但就在其二人对望一眼之后，本来也自打算随那五人走向后宅的一名中年人，却向那五人说了几句之后，随着另一名中年人一起离开了分舵驻地。
面对二人的如此动作，秦凤鸣虽然入世历练不多，但其也自感到了一丝异样存在其中。
身形晃动之下，秦凤鸣便自出离了落霞谷分舵所在。
隐身在阴暗之中，在碧云迷踪身法的急速之下，悄无声息的跟随在了那两名离去中年身后十几丈处。
那二人一路之上并未回头，也未有丝毫交谈，一切显得都极为平静。
拐弯抹角之后，二人便进入到了一处有三进院子的宅院。
此时，已然到了深夜子时，整个宅院已然灯火皆无。
随着那两名中年进入宅院，片刻后，三进院落中的一间房间陡然亮起了灯光。
秦凤鸣并未在前院停留，而是直接来到了后花园，隐身在那灯光露出的窗户之外，凝神细听房间二人说话。
“黄兄，对于刚才舵主所言，不知你有何高见？”
刚自落座，其中一人便自开口说道。
其语声极为阴沉，好像其所说之事极为重大严重一般。
“哼，高见？能有什么高见？王兄难道还想让我出卖一次落霞谷不成？”
听闻那人之言，另外一人恨声开口回到。
听此人意思，好像原先之时，二人却是曾经出卖过落霞谷。
“哈哈哈，黄兄不要忘记了，当初之事，你也有份在其中的。
如不是你贪恋醉红楼的金雀姑娘，我等怎么会有把柄落入天苍山王氏双鹰手中。”

“哼，你还有脸说此事，虽然当初是我贪恋那窑姐，与那魏虎相争，但在后面鼓动之人却是你，后来想想，定然是你与那魏虎勾结，故意设套陷害与我无疑。
虽然那次我同意中饱私囊，监守自盗贪墨了分舵的银两，但此次，我势必不会再与你同流合污了。”
那黄姓中年越说越是气愤，最后更是面色极为不善起来。
“哈哈哈，贪墨一次分舵银两？黄兄不要忘记了，那次小梁山我数十名弟子被伏击之事，可也是你告诉的。
事后也有一笔银子落入你户头之中。”
“什么？那次之事也是天苍山王氏双鹰所为？不是说是吴山之人做的吗？啊，我知晓了，定然也是你故意如此说的。
好、好，王鹏，你真是好心机，竟然一步步将黄某逼上绝路。
你就不怕我此时出手将你灭杀吗？”
始闻此言，那黄姓中年登时目露凶芒，双手一晃，便欲向对面中年扑去。
“黄兄且慢，我还有话要说。
你武功高过与我，此点王某心中知晓非常，对此，王某早有后手，只要身死，黄兄当初所做之事，立即便有人将之告诉张青山知晓。
如黄兄不信，大可一试。”
content_en:
Looking at the backs of everyone leaving, Qin Fengming couldn't help but feel a little strange.
Qin Fengming didn't feel anything strange about the five people stranded at the helm.
But the two middle-aged men who were walking outside the helm looked at each other when they left the building.
Although there was nothing strange about this action, just after the two of them looked at each other, a middle-aged man who originally planned to follow the five people to the back house said a few words to the five people and then left the branch station with the other middle-aged man.
Facing such actions of the two men, although Qin Fengming had little experience in the world, he felt a little strange in them.
With his figure swaying, Qin Fengming left the Luoxia Valley branch.
Invisible in the darkness, under the rapidity of Biyun's Mysterious Body Technique, he followed silently ten feet behind the two departing middle-aged men.
The two people didn't look back or talk at all along the way. Everything seemed extremely calm.
After beating around the bush, the two entered a house with three courtyards.
At this time, it was already late at night, and the entire house was completely dark.
As the two middle-aged people entered the house, a moment later, a room in the third courtyard suddenly lit up.
Qin Fengming did not stop in the front yard, but went directly to the back garden, hiding outside the window where the light was exposed, and listened carefully to the conversation between the two people in the room.
"Brother Huang, what do you have to say about what the helmsman said just now?"
As soon as they sat down, one of them spoke.
His voice was extremely gloomy, as if what he was saying was extremely important and serious.
"Humph, what good advice can you have? Does Brother Wang still want me to betray Luoxia Valley once?"
Hearing what that person said, the other person came back with an angry voice.
From what this person meant, it seemed that the two of them had betrayed Luoxia Valley before.
"Hahaha, Brother Huang, don't forget that you were also involved in what happened in the first place.
If you hadn't been infatuated with the golden bird girl who was drunk in the red building, how could we have fallen into the hands of Wang's Shuangying in Tiancang Mountain. "
"Hmph, you still have the nerve to talk about this. Although I was the one who was greedy for that kiln sister and fought with that Wei Hu at the beginning, but it was you who was the instigator behind it. Thinking about it later, it must be you who colluded with that Wei Hu and deliberately set up a trap to frame me.
Although I agreed to enrich my own pocket that time and stole and embezzled the money allocated to the helm, but this time, I will definitely not collude with you again. "
The middle-aged man surnamed Huang became angrier and angrier as he spoke, and in the end his expression turned extremely evil.
"Hahaha, Tan Mo split the helm and silver at once? Brother Huang, don't forget, it was you who told me that dozens of my disciples were ambushed in Xiaoliang Mountain.
Later, a sum of money fell into your account. "
"What? That incident was also done by Wang's Shuangying of Tiancang Mountain? Didn't you say it was done by people from Wushan? Ah, I know, you must have said that on purpose.
Okay, okay, Wang Peng, you are so scheming, and you actually drove Huang to a dead end step by step.
Aren't you afraid that I will kill you right now? "
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged man surnamed Huang suddenly showed a fierce look in his eyes, and with a wave of his hands, he was about to pounce on the middle-aged man opposite.
"Brother Huang, wait a minute, I have something else to say.
Your martial arts skills are superior to mine, and Wang knows this in his heart. Wang has already had a back-up plan. As long as he dies, what Brother Huang did back then will be immediately reported to Zhang Qingshan.
If Brother Huang doesn't believe it, you can give it a try. "
